name: chart-table
description: XY chart of a table. This is how MassFlow results are read: 'massflow record' writes extracted mass per period into a table, 'massflow drawpoint dump-drawperiod' writes a draw schedule into one, and 'massflow marker size-distribution' writes the cumulative fragment-size curve into one.

basic_keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
Table to plot, by name or number.
Configure the x axis (label, log, limits, exponent).
Configure the y axis (label, log, limits, exponent).
Draw a glyph at each data point.
Swap the x and y series.
Set item transparency (0 opaque .. 100 fully transparent).

common_usage_patterns.command: plot item create chart-table table 'all DPs'
common_usage_patterns.description: Plot the table written by `massflow record name 'all DPs'`.

common_usage_patterns.command: plot item create chart-table table 'size-distribution' axis-x log on
common_usage_patterns.description: Plot the cumulative percent-passing curve written by `massflow marker size-distribution`, with a log size axis.

notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against MassFlow 3D 9.
